“ Don't even think about running... Everything in the school gates is mine! „

Student Council Delinquent (Korean: ) is White Peach Cookie's second Costume, released during the Galactic Empire's March to Glory! update, as part of the CookieRun: Crumble Launch Event! to celebrate Cookie Run: Crumble's release. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained by reaching Stage 15-1 in Cookie Run: Crumble.

Story

Rumors spread like a quick-acting poison of a student council president who took over her entire school while decked out in a full-length wine-colored skirt and with a rebellious look in her eye. Students dare not cross her path, because she ruthlessly dishes out punishments and demerit points at the slightest infraction of the hundreds of school rules. Following such strict rules and standards is difficult for even the most well-behaved of students, but as long as you follow the rules to the T she can, supposedly, be quite nice.

Trivia

  • Student Council Delinquent was released alongside  Reserved Model Student.
  • Student Council Delinquent features White Peach Cookie dressed as Dark Cherry Cookie.

“ An antidote? Oh, I have one. But I've no intention of giving it to you. „

Venomcrafting Vicar (Korean: 흑마교 만독대장로, heungmagyo mandokdaejangno, "Black Demon Cult's Grand Elder of All Poisons") is White Peach Cookie's first Costume, released accompanying her in the second half of The Legend of the Spirit Weapons update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

After mastering every poison under the sun, White Peach Cookie is said to have created a venom both colorless and scentless. Behind drifting petals of peach blossoms, she conceals venom-tipped daggers and lets them fly. Beware, for if you lose yourself in the spectacle, you'll already be succumbing to her toxin. Should you wish for an antidote, she invites you to seek her out at the Cult of the Umbral Pact... but what scheme lies behind that invitation?

Trivia

  • Venomcrafting Vicar was released alongside  Venomwing Butterfly,  Nimble Delivery Dasher, and  Head Dumpling Chef.
